turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class.
Thanks for coming in.
Okay. You asked for this meeting, Hale. What is it you want to tell me?
I wanted to talk about Owen's essay.
Then talk about it. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
How has his semester been at home?
His semester at home is my business, Hale. You haven't answered me: who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
He seems tired in class lately.
"Tired in class." Is that what the zero rests on, Hale? I'm writing that down. Tell me what else you have.
I know he works at the grocery store.
So does half the neighbourhood. What does a part-time job have to do with a zero entered before anyone called me?
The essay came in on time, which was good.
Then it was on time and he did the work. So why is there a zero, Hale?
I did have some concerns about it though.
"Some concerns." On what basis, and did you raise them with Owen before you entered a zero?
The school's checker flagged it.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student, and I have that printed in my bag. What else do you have, Hale?
I know those tools aren't perfect.
"Aren't perfect." Then you entered a zero on a tool you know isn't reliable, before you called me. What else do you have, or is that all of it?
I also looked at the version history.
Okay. I'm writing that down. What does it show, Hale?
It was created very late the night before.
"Very late" isn't a time, Hale. Which night, what exact time, and can I see the history myself? Owen tells me he wrote that essay over the weekend.
Most of it arrived in two big pieces.
"Two big pieces." Students move text between documents all the time, Hale. You still haven't given me a time or a page I can read, so what exactly are you asking me to accept?
I asked Owen about his thesis afterward.
"Afterward." After the zero went in? And what did he say, Hale?
He had trouble explaining it.
"Had trouble explaining it." A seventeen-year-old, asked by the teacher who had already entered a zero, with no parent in the room. Is that your evidence, Hale?
I'm not trying to get him in trouble.
"Not trying to get him in trouble." Then withdraw the zero, Hale. It's the only thing in this room that is trouble for him.
What do you think should happen next?
You're asking me how to do your job? Withdraw the zero, apologize to Owen for how he found out, and tell me today that you've done it, or I'm going to the principal's office when we're done here.
What would you do if you were me?
I'm not you, Hale, and I'm not here to be your adviser. Take the zero off, then tell me what you actually have. Ten minutes.
Okay. Let's talk about the rewrite option.
A rewrite of what, Hale? An essay you've given a zero to, on a checker score and "two big pieces," with no time and no page I can read. The zero comes off first, then we talk about anything else.
It would be at lunch, in my room.
Lunch, in your room. Who else is in that room, Hale, and what does it say on his record when he walks out? I'm not agreeing to anything while the zero is still in the gradebook.
Nothing goes on file if it holds up.
"If it holds up." Held up against what standard, Hale, and who decides? I want "nothing goes on file" in writing, with no condition, and the zero off before he writes a word.
Can you summarize where we are in a list?
Put it in an email yourself, Hale. My terms haven't changed: the zero comes off, nothing goes on his file, and I have it in writing.
Thanks for your time.
We're not finished, Hale. The zero is still in the gradebook, and I have nothing in writing. Two minutes: what are you doing about both?
